name: Primo Packaging
old_description: As a trusted manufacturer and converter, Primo Packaging produces durable, customizable plastic bags designed to meet your exact specifications. From raw material to finished product, every step of our process is engineered for consistency, efficiency, and quality.
about:
Primo Packaging operates from a facility on North Orange Blossom Trail in Orlando, Florida. The company's founding date and ownership structure have not been publicly disclosed.

The company functions as a manufacturer and converter of flexible plastic packaging, producing custom bags and pouches for a range of end uses. Its process capabilities include eight-color process printing, four lamination methods (solvent, extrusion, dry, and co-extrusion), and the fabrication of numerous bag styles such as stand-up pouches, wicketed bags, poly mailers, gusseted bags, and vacuum pouches. Materials processed span polyethylene, polypropylene, BOPP, CPP, PET, PVDC, nylon, and specialty co-extruded films, supplied as roll stock or converted into finished bags.

Primo Packaging serves customers in confectionery, bakeries, snack foods, pet products, meat and fish processing, agriculture, and landscaping, among other sectors. The company does not publish a client list, but its stated industry focus indicates a broad base of food and non-food packagers.

According to its own description, Primo Packaging engineers every step from raw material to finished product for consistency, efficiency, and quality, positioning itself as a partner for brands that require precise graphics and reliable packaging performance.
